heading: Harry’s Priorities
text: Real plans, not slogans — the work Harry is focused on for District 1.

heading: Harry’s Priorities
text: Harry believes your government should make everyday life a little easier — not get distracted by political games.

heading: Harry’s Priorities
text: Since joining the Commission, he has focused on the work that matters and the results Hillsborough County families are counting on. Here is where he stands.

heading: Harry Cohen has plans, not slogans
text: Seven priorities, and a real plan behind each one.

heading: Improving Transportation & Infrastructure
text: Traffic affects almost every part of daily life. It determines how long residents spend commuting, how quickly first responders can reach an emergency, and whether local businesses can continue growing.

heading: Improving Transportation & Infrastructure
text: Through his work on the Transportation Planning Organization, Harry has helped shape regional conversations about transportation, infrastructure, safety, and the needs created by Hillsborough County’s continued growth.

heading: Improving Transportation & Infrastructure
text: He understands that the county cannot simply approve more development and hope the roads catch up later.

heading: Improving Transportation & Infrastructure
text: Harry will continue working to move transportation projects forward, improve safety, address congestion, and make it easier for residents to get to work, school, appointments, and home.

heading: Protecting Our Water & Environment
text: Reliable water is one of the most important responsibilities of local government.

heading: Protecting Our Water & Environment
text: As the immediate past chair of Tampa Bay Water and the current vice chair of the Environmental Protection Commission, Harry is helping guide decisions that affect the region’s water supply, natural resources, and long-term environmental future.

heading: Protecting Our Water & Environment
text: He also serves on the Tampa Bay Regional Planning Council, where communities work together on issues that do not stop at city or county lines.

heading: Protecting Our Water & Environment
text: Harry knows that protecting our water and preparing for future growth require planning today. He will continue working to ensure Hillsborough County has the resources and infrastructure necessary to serve residents for generations to come.

heading: Standing Up for Affordable Housing
text: Too many Hillsborough County residents are struggling to find a home they can afford. Working families, seniors, young people, and residents recovering from hurricanes are being pushed farther from the communities they call home.

heading: Standing Up for Affordable Housing
text: When the County Commission moved to eliminate dedicated funding under the HOPE Affordable Housing Act, Harry voted to protect that investment.

heading: Standing Up for Affordable Housing
text: He argued that the housing crisis would not disappear and that the county must continue using its resources to attract additional funding and create real solutions.

heading: Standing Up for Affordable Housing
text: Harry will keep fighting for practical housing investments that help residents remain in Hillsborough County and give more families the opportunity to build a stable future here.

heading: Supporting Public Safety & Essential Services
text: County government is responsible for services residents rely on during their most difficult moments.

heading: Supporting Public Safety & Essential Services
text: Harry believes law enforcement officers, firefighters, paramedics, emergency personnel, and county employees must have the resources necessary to serve a growing community.

heading: Supporting Public Safety & Essential Services
text: He also understands that public safety cannot be separated from strong infrastructure, emergency planning, housing stability, and dependable county services.

heading: Supporting Public Safety & Essential Services
text: Harry takes a complete approach to keeping residents safe and making sure help is available when it is needed.

heading: Managing Growth Responsibly
text: Hillsborough County continues to attract new residents and businesses, but growth must be managed in a way that protects the people already living here.

heading: Managing Growth Responsibly
text: New development affects traffic, drainage, water, emergency services, housing, and the character of surrounding neighborhoods.

heading: Managing Growth Responsibly
text: Harry believes county leaders must look beyond the next project and consider how today’s decisions will affect residents years from now.

heading: Managing Growth Responsibly
text: He will continue pushing for responsible planning, stronger infrastructure, and development decisions that improve the community instead of leaving existing residents to deal with the consequences.

heading: Protecting Taxpayers & County Services
text: Residents deserve a county government that respects their money and delivers services effectively.

heading: Protecting Taxpayers & County Services
text: Harry approaches county decisions by asking whether they solve a real problem, protect essential services, and provide long-term value.

heading: Protecting Taxpayers & County Services
text: He understands that responsible budgeting is not simply about cutting a number on a spreadsheet. It is about making careful choices, eliminating waste, and protecting the services residents depend on.

heading: Protecting Taxpayers & County Services
text: With significant uncertainty surrounding potential changes to local government funding, Harry has emphasized the importance of protecting the county’s ability to deliver core services without creating unnecessary disruption for residents.

heading: Making County Government Work for You
text: Residents should not have to fight through layers of government to report a problem, receive an answer, or access a service.

heading: Making County Government Work for You
text: Harry believes a county commissioner should be present, responsive, and willing to follow an issue until it is resolved.

heading: Making County Government Work for You
text: Whether the concern is flooding on a neighborhood street, a transportation problem, a county service, or the impact of new development, Harry listens and works to find a practical path forward.

heading: Making County Government Work for You
text: That is what effective local government looks like: fewer political games, more follow-through, and results that make life a little easier.
